definition: copy-level: exact OR cos >= theta OR pHash <= tau (dHash reference only)
positives: .rf groups of the set, groups with any pair cos < 0.5 dropped
negatives: random cross-source pairs; MD5/stem-identical pairs dropped

operating_point.role: copy-level (2a) operating point, precision-conservative: theta 0.98 reaches P >= 0.99 on held-out B with same-set negatives (within_set_holdout); the cross-source calibration (theta 0.485, tau 16) merges 99.98% of PPE-Unified into one group (see threshold_sensitivity). Scene-level duplicates are handled by 2b (file-name sequence, frame numbers within +-2), not by a threshold.
